lines.en: Hello. How much are these apples?
Two apples for one thousand.
I will take six apples, please.
Six apples. Do you need eggs too?
Yes. Give me ten eggs.
Here you are. One, two, three, ten.
Yesterday I bought four fish here.
lines.ko: 어제 여기서 생선 네 마리를 샀어요.

lines.en: Was the fish good yesterday?
It was very good. My grandson ate three last night.
lines.ko: 아주 맛있었어요. 어젯밤에 손자가 세 마리를 먹었어요.

lines.en: Thank you. Come again soon!
Let's count your fingers. One, two, three.
lines.ko: 손가락을 세어요. 하나, 둘, 셋 해 봐요.

lines.en: Four, five! Grandma, how many fingers do I have?
lines.ko: 넷, 다섯! 할머니, 제 손가락은 몇 개예요?

lines.en: You have ten fingers. Count them all.
lines.ko: 손가락이 열 개예요. 다 세어 봐요.

lines.en: Six, seven, eight, nine, ten! That's ten!
lines.ko: 여섯, 일곱, 여덟, 아홉, 열! 열이에요!

lines.en: Very good! Yesterday you stopped at seven.
Can we count the birds outside?
lines.ko: 밖에 있는 새도 세어 볼 수 있어요?

lines.en: Sure. How many birds do you see?
I see two birds on the tree.
lines.ko: 나무 위에 새 두 마리가 보여요.

lines.en: Tomorrow we will count the cars together.
lines.ko: 내일은 같이 자동차를 세어 볼 거예요.

lines.en: Yes! I will count to one hundred.
